items.text: This hotfix is mainly fixing user levels and adding new stuff for the modders.
Updating / Uploading levels not working
Wall Tower objects / formations broken on existing user maps
Repeat action script command only executing once
Game Script has direction now
You can define positions in script relative to the target's position and direction
Read more about Action Scripting here

Minimap shows the wrong number of enemies on the map on game load. The counter was increased for the additional number of enemies killed. That may also have prevented the end-level statistic counter from working properly and the achievements from triggering.
We're back with a long-overdue update, and it's a big one! It's packed with fixes and updates, and we've even added something new for players and modders.

Master Explorers can now spend their hard-earned treasure on additional weapon upgrades. Mages afraid of spiders can turn on the Arachnophobia filter and face creatures that have fewer legs. Modders can now write action scripts inside the editor to form exciting events. Have you encountered Ghost Ladies disappearing behind the walls? We got it covered!
All that and much more!
Additional 7 weapon upgrades and a new shop section added to the game to use the hard-earned treasure from secret hunting
\[Fire Rings] Blaze Surge - 25% chance to trigger Blaze Surge after killing an enemy with Fire Rings, triggering 50% increased attack speed with Fire Rings for 5 seconds
\ Pierceblast - Normal attack penetrates one additional target
\ Frost Mastery - Remove ammo cost for the Secondary Attack
\ Fiery Warmth - Receive 50% less damage from your own Pyroblast explosion.
\[Storm Gauntlets] Lightning Reach - Increase the lightning reach distance by 20%.
\[Faewood Crossbow] Sylvan Afterbite - Killing an enemy with a primary attack has a 25% chance to spawn a poison AOE cloud at the enemy's position (only damaging other enemies).
\[Staff of Chaos] Focus Blast - Decreases the projectile spread by 50%.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/44a09cd48557abc72935238876d37b317dff7952.png"]
Level Editor
Action Script

You can now write action scripts inside the level editor to spawn effects, enemies, activate other objects, hurt or heal the player, wait for a duration or for the player's health to drop below a specific amount, and more! The best part? You can share these scripts with fellow modders!
Settings
New input setting to allow mouse look while playing with the controller.
Arachnophobia Filter - we've heard some of you aren't on the best terms with spiders, so we added a filter that turns them into something else.
Saving and loading game progress got another safety layer to prevent profile corruption. This includes a fix for a bug that keeps the game on a black screen when entering it.
Shootable switches can be hit by Stormgauntlets as well now
Banshee enemy can be hit when charging now, but for 50% less damage
Enemy Spawn Sound updated - slightly changed, louder, and can be heard from a greater distance
Secret shootable Switch from E1L02 moved to a slightly more visible place
Rat Mount look / rotation speed increased
When navigating the menu with the keyboard, the 'F' key is now used for confirmation instead of 'E' to prevent clashes with Next / Previous Tab selection (Q/E).
Minimap navigation updated so it uses gameplay controls instead of a separate, fixed one
If your movement keys are ESDF, then those will be used for minimap scrolling
Toggling minimap mode (and flipping Lore pages) is done by the "Use Consumable" key, and Marker type is changed with Next / Prev Weapon keys.
Level Editing / Modding
Sprite Atlas support added for Custom Decor
Grenade, Special Attack, and Death hand sprites are now moddable
Custom liquid tiles in the tileset will replace original liquid tiles
New "Invisible Switch" type - one-sided.
Connection lines of selected/hovered objects are now shown as thick white lines to easily see them in the mess
All enemies are now moddable
Additional tiles and decor
When using a custom tileset, you can decide for each level in your adventure which tileset it uses - custom or classic.
Creature counter in some levels decreases after loading the game (usually when blocks that enemies stand on are destroyed)

items.text: We got some reports that Mod.io Steam authentication is not working, making the user content unavailable (email authnetication option worked as an alternative).
At first we believed this was connected to recent Steam server issues but after further inspection we've learnt that the problem was on our end, introduced with the previous patch.
Steam Authentication option should now be back and working!
We apologize for the invonviniences this caused to you and thank you for your reports and patience.
Wrong icon and display name for the Dagger in Weapon Wheel menu
Winter's End Tomb secret can't be opened
Dagger "Raw Mana" red glow effect offsetted
We are aware of the gamepad issues and we will get on that first thing after the holidays.

We shadow-dropped support for custom weapon sprites. Since this feature is new, it's not 100% there yet, but you can already change sprites for most of the weapons. We don't have this in the editor's guide so if you want to learn how, come around our Discord.
While there are lots of great user-adventures available (have you played Halloween entries yet?!) you should definitelly check these two out first.
Holiday Special (link)
This is the most Christmasy Wizordum mod available and it is full of excellent references and funny moments. You won't be able to put it down!
Return to Wolfendum (link)

Why play Wolfenstein in Wizordum, you ask? Because you’ve probably never fought *********** before. Well, you probably have. But that will never be not fun, right? This is a wonderful tribute to Wolfenstein 3D: Spear of Destiny. This is also the first mod that is utilizing custom weapon sprites.

releases.displayName: New Class Update: Bloodmage - Out Now on PC

items.text: The Bloodmage is here, introducing the most punishing and rewarding way to play Wizordum yet.

This new character flips the rules of survival on their head. There are no health pickups, no potions, and no easy outs. If you want to live, you must fight smarter, cast harder, and embrace the chaos.
❌ No health potions or consumables
🩸 Healing comes only from spells and weapons
🌿 Environmental healing is removed or corrupted
🔪 A unique Dagger that heals you on kills
Secondary attack: a deadly lunge
⚔️ Aggressive, risk-reward combat that rewards mastery
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/38ecfc010709b0cd87beeebea026494e0a88d614.png"]
Blood Rune – Place a rune that explodes when enemies draw near
Crimson Harvest – Homing projectiles that heal you based on damage dealt
Blood Fountain – Drop fountain on your enemies and drink from the health pool
Sanguine Sacrifice – Bleed health over time to gain massive attack speed and power; kills during this state heal you
Special Ability: Bloodflare Nova
Push enemies away as their blood boils, dealing damage over time and restoring your health in the process.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/0fef712b3ce4ac5aaaf1874727d34b61380b568a.png"]
Dragonbreath potion (replaces Health Elixir) - Increase fire damage by 20%
Spell Shard (replaces Health Shard) - replenish small amount of Spell-charge
The Bloodmage update is available now on PC.

As a small indie team, porting and certifying major gameplay systems takes time. We wanted to get the Bloodmage into players’ hands early, gather feedback, and make sure the experience is dialed in before bringing it to consoles.
💬 Your feedback matters
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/4f76236f73d0aa0b4bf3f5541ca8dd8127f45574.png"]

items.text: We have an important update to share with you.

A security vulnerability has been identified that affects games and applications built using Unity. While there is currently no evidence of impact on users, we’re taking all relevant steps to ensure you’re on the latest and safest version of the game. To keep you safe, we’ve released a new patch immediately after the news that addresses this issue.

notes.title: You can read more about this in Unity's official statement

items.text: Please update the game as soon as possible to stay protected! [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1715590/Wizordum/"]

We are bringing online user adventure browser to consoles soon and for that, we had to apply some changes to the level editor so that maps created/updated by PC users are automatically available on consoles as well.
For this opportunity we also added some new things to the level editor and applied a crucial fix to the game.
Barrel ride stops working in the Eldertstone Mines
This ongoing bug should be finally fixed now. If your save game places you close to a barrel, move to the portal out of the cave and back to the barrel to "fix" the issue.

Gamepad controls couldn't (and still can't) be changed, but the system allowed binding gamepad buttons, which trigger double-controller bind issues. As a result, we now filter out gamepad button prompts when assigning a new key to avoid confusion.

This update adds Lore Fragments to all existing levels, which speak of events and sometimes hint at hidden areas and puzzles. By discovering all of these concealed fragments, players will unlock the corresponding Chronicle for each level, providing insights into their lore. We also added two new achievements related to them for the brave explorers.

We promised that we would keep expanding the modding capabilities for Wizordum, and this is the first step on that path. You can now, through the mod script, mod existing enemies, changing their sprites, health, and damage they deal. We also prepared a guide so you can have a quick start at it!

For a long time (even in the Early Access), lots of players had problems finding the last 1% of the treasure. Treasure seeking was part of our initial idea, and it is in no way mandatory, but we know there are lots of you who enjoy the process. However, missing the last 1% can be really annoying, especially when a pile of copper coins hides amongst barrel remains.

That's why we added a new character update to the shop - Moonlight Chart. After collecting 98% of the treasure in the level, the rest will be revealed on your magic map (goblet icon). You still need to find the majority of the treasure, but the upgrade will help you with the final pieces and save you some trouble.

The sorceress is a formidable magic wielder, relying upon raw arcane powers to dominate the battlefield. Clothed in flowing robes that accentuate her movements, she unleashes devastating as well as strong protective spells that make her untouchable.
Fast and deadly in the hands of experienced players.

This is the first new character we are adding to the game. We want each character to unlock a new way of playing the game by giving them a different starting weapon, spells, and stats.

First, I would like to address the change to the Save System. You might have noticed that your save files got corrupted a few times already since the release with almost every update. We tried to solve this issue without making significant changes, but we realized that's impossible with our flawed system. So, to provide long-term support and stability of your save files, we had to rewrite how the save games work. That includes changes to the level format. We apologize for the possible loss of your current save game files. This should provide stability for a long while.
Last but not least, we are planning some things for January 2024:
Roadmap to show you where we're heading and what can you expect from the game in the future
First Map Making event

notes.title: Safety of your Save Games in the long run

items.text: Your current save files are safe this time, but we found a severe issue with the save game system, which prevents us from keeping the save games safe in the long run through updates. We will have to rewrite this part to provide persistable save files that are safe from corruption. When we release that update, we will also provide a backup branch that will allow you to play the previous version, so you can finish the game without losing the saves.

One week has passed since we launched our first public demo, and the response we have received so far is astounding! It is nice to see many players enjoying the game, even if it's just a small demo, which means we are doing something right, and we'll keep doing what we do.
Although the feedback was overall very positive, you also reported some issues you were having with the game, so we tried to address most of them in this patch.
FOV slider added
Hitboxes and projectiles improved (you will hardly miss now with your weapons, and rats are much less of an annoyance)

Default game settings updated

If you enter the passage (transition) while the pickup effect is in progress, the pickup glow effect won't be stuck.
With all these changes, the demo should be much more enjoyable, all thanks to your feedback! There are other things that we will be updating and fixing, but it will take a bit longer.

We read and appreciate all the feedback we get, even if we don't reply to you immediately. If you are new here, feel free to leave your feedback on Steam Forums, Discord or send it directly to our email.
Wizordum is 100% funded by Patreon, so if you would like to support the game further, this is something you can consider. Every little bit helps! ːcc_candleː
Thank you for your support, enjoy the game! 🧙‍♂️
